title: Jives Coffee Lounge
venue_description:
Overview

Jives Coffee Lounge is a beloved coffee shop and music venue located in Old Colorado City Colorado Springs. Operating under the motto Coffee Music Life Jives has established itself as a community gathering place that combines quality coffee specialty drinks and live music in a welcoming family-friendly atmosphere.

Music Events

The venue hosts a variety of music events throughout the week. Wednesday nights from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM feature The Over-Prepared Open Mic with signups starting at 5:30 PM and performances beginning at 6:00 PM hosted by Poet North Star. Thursday evenings showcase Irish Pub Music from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Live music performances by local talent take place on Friday and Saturday nights creating a vibrant atmosphere for music lovers.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The lounge features eclectic quirky decor with mismatched furniture a red piano and a guitar adorned with Elvis photos. Both indoor and outdoor seating options are available with a shaded patio perfect for enjoying Colorado weather. The venue is dog-friendly and welcomes pets making it a popular spot for the entire family. The spacious interior provides ample seating for relaxation and socializing.

Food and Drink

Jives serves a wide variety of specialty coffee drinks including the popular White Tiger mocha Red Moon latte spicy mocha with cayenne pepper and chai lattes. Fresh smoothies are also available. The menu includes sandwiches pastries bagels and light meals to accompany beverages. Hours are Monday through Tuesday 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM Wednesday 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM Thursday through Saturday 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Sunday 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

title: Vultures
venue_description:
Overview

Vultures is Colorado Springs newest neighborhood bar and music venue located in the Knob Hill Arts District at 2100 E Platte Ave. This unique establishment combines the intimate atmosphere of a dive bar with professional sound and lighting creating an exceptional environment for experiencing live music and building community.

Music Programming

The venue hosts Open Mic Night every Monday with signups at 6:00 PM and performances starting around 7:00 PM hosted by Joe Bruno. Musicians and comedians are welcome to showcase their talents. Throughout the week Vultures features live bands across diverse genres including rock indie punk alternative and more. The venue has earned a reputation for booking amazing bands and providing a platform for budding young artists from the Pikes Peak region and beyond.

Venue Features

With a capacity of 150 people Vultures offers an intimate concert experience with quality sound and lights comparable to larger venues but with a coffee shop or basement show feel. The walls are decorated with old posters and knickknacks including quirky details like a tiny skateboard and disco ball creating a unique visual aesthetic. The venue is all ages unless otherwise stated making live music accessible to the entire community.

Food Drink and Hours

Vultures serves drinks and fun twists on comfort food at fair prices. The full bar offers cocktails and beverages. Happy hour runs from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM daily. The venue is open Monday through Sunday from 4:00 PM to 2:00 AM. Known for friendly staff from the bouncer to the bartender Vultures has quickly become a favorite music venue in Colorado Springs.
location: 2100 E Platte Ave Colorado Springs CO 80909

title: Kinfolks
venue_description:
Overview

Kinfolks is a craft beer bar and live music venue located at 950 Manitou Ave in the heart of historic downtown Manitou Springs. Specializing in craft beer and live music Kinfolks offers a rotating selection of craft beers from across the United States along with a hand-picked selection of small batch bourbons whiskeys and wine.

Music and Events

Every Wednesday night Kinfolks hosts an open mic starting at 7:30 PM hosted by Ramsey providing a stage for local musicians and performers. Throughout the week the venue showcases local and national musical acts creating an intimate atmosphere for quality live performances. The venue has become known for its excellent music programming and welcoming environment for both performers and music lovers.

Food and Drink

The venue proudly serves savory meat pies made locally by Mountain Pie Co. The rotating craft beer selection features harder-to-find gems from outside Colorado along with Colorado favorites. The emphasis on small batch spirits provides options for bourbon and whiskey enthusiasts. The dog-friendly outdoor patio makes it a great spot for pet owners to relax with their furry friends.

Hours and Details

Kinfolks is closed on Mondays and Sundays. Operating hours are Tuesday through Friday 5:00 PM to 12:00 AM and Saturday 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM to 12:00 AM for brunch and evening service. The venue accepts credit cards and takes reservations. The casual atmosphere and moderate noise level make it perfect for enjoying craft beer and live music in a relaxed setting.

title: Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort
venue_description:
Overview

The Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort is a unique 46-room boutique hotel that has been serving the Colorado Springs area since 1919 when it first opened as a hunting lodge. Located at 2 El Paso Blvd at the gateway between Old Colorado City and Manitou Springs the lodge seamlessly blends outdoor recreation cycling culture and live music into a distinctive hospitality experience.

Music Programming

The Buffalo Lodge features live music five nights a week Wednesday through Sunday with a focus on folk Americana and bluegrass. The Black Rose Acoustic Society hosts Open Mic nights on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday of each month from 6:00 PM to 8:40 PM followed by an open jam until 9:00 PM. Performers can register starting at 5:30 PM for a 3-song set on a first-come first-served basis. Sunday afternoons from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM feature the Colorado Springs Pickers Bluegrass Jam hosted by Joy Maples. The venue also presents Unplugged at the Lodge and various live concerts throughout the week.

Annual Events

The lodge hosts the BuffaloGrass Music Festival each October a three-day celebration of bluegrass and acoustic music featuring 16 bands across two stages. The festival includes daily picking circles and jam sessions yoga Aqua Zumba group bike rides How to Jam classes and local food trucks. The intimate setting provides excellent acoustics and a family-friendly environment that has made it a favorite among musicians and fans alike.

Amenities

As a bicycle resort the lodge offers a fleet of bikes for overnight guests and each ground-level room has a bicycle rack. The property is located near numerous trails making it perfect for cycling enthusiasts. However guests dont need to be bicyclists to enjoy the lodge. The Watering Hole bar features Happy Hour from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Limited parking is available at the back of the property. The lodge welcomes both overnight guests and local visitors to enjoy the music and atmosphere.
location: 2 El Paso Blvd Colorado Springs CO 80904

title: Armadillo Ranch
venue_description:
Overview

Armadillo Ranch is a historic bar restaurant and live music venue located at 962 Manitou Ave in the heart of downtown Manitou Springs. The venue occupies the former Ancient Mariner building and has become a cornerstone of the local music scene offering community live music local art quality ingredients regional brews unique cocktails and good vibes.

Music Programming

The venue presents live music five days a week featuring local and regional artists across multiple genres including rock jam funk bluegrass americana folk reggae singer-songwriter and covers from the 60s through 90s. Monday nights feature Jazz Jam Sessions from 7:00 PM to 9:30 PM co-sponsored by the Pikes Peak Jazz and Swing Society and Tidal Breeze Jazz Arts. Various jazz musicians host throughout the month including saxophonist Adam Gang and guitarist Colin McAllister providing a professional rhythm section for all-ages jazz jams. Thursday Friday and Saturday nights showcase live bands starting at 8:00 PM.

Food and Drink

The menu features chef-prepared selections including burgers sandwiches in-house smoked pork delicious wings and a kids menu. Vegetarian vegan and gluten-free options are available. The venue emphasizes local and organic products when possible following global and slow food-inspired cuisine principles. Regional craft beers unique cocktails and a selection of wine and spirits round out the beverage offerings.

Additional Events and Details

Beyond music Armadillo Ranch hosts trivia karaoke and drag brunches creating diverse entertainment options. A 3.50 dollar entertainment fee per person is added to tabs during live music shows to support the local artist community. The venue is open for lunch and dinner with a welcoming atmosphere that encourages guests to dine enjoy drinks and stay for the entertainment. Contact the venue at manitouarmadilloranch@gmail.com for questions.

title: Black Rose Acoustic Society Venues
venue_description:
Overview

The Black Rose Acoustic Society has been the home of live handmade acoustic music in the Pikes Peak Region for over 30 years. The organization presents concerts at the Black Forest Community Center and hosts jam sessions and open mics at various venues throughout Colorado Springs including Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort Beth-el Mennonite Church All Souls Unitarian Universalist Church and Treehouse Cafe.

Concert Series

Twice each month on second and fourth Fridays the Black Rose holds concerts at the Black Forest Community Center just north of Colorado Springs. The log-cabin concert hall provides a family-oriented setting with outstanding acoustics and a down-home atmosphere. National and regional musicians regularly perform as feature acts. The open-stage format encourages performers at all levels with friendly supportive audiences. The legendary Black Rose Stomp occurs when the old oak floor shakes with sustained roaring approval for exceptional performances.

Jam Sessions

The Black Rose hosts numerous jam sessions throughout the month in various genres and skill levels. Festival Bluegrass Jams are held on the 1st and 3rd Mondays at Beth-el Mennonite Church from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM emphasizing festival etiquette where musicians dont rely on written music. Other jams include Beginning and Intermediate Bluegrass Pop and Rock from the 60s and beyond Fiddle Tunes Gospel Select Handpicked Jams featuring different songwriters each month Gypsy Swing Django Reinhardt jazz and Blues Jam on 4th Thursdays at All Souls Unitarian Church.

Open Mic

Open Mic nights are held on the 2nd and 4th Wednesdays at Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort from 6:00 PM to 8:40 PM followed by an open jam until 9:00 PM. Musicians can sign up starting at 5:30 PM for a 3-song set on a first-come first-served basis. This provides new and beginning musicians a chance to perform in front of a smaller audience. Saturday morning Hootenanny Jams are held at Treehouse Cafe from 10:00 AM to noon.

Community and Mission

Making music with others is central to the Black Rose mission. All jam levels are welcome from beginner to advanced. The organization provides a small donation to help cover room rentals. Jam reminder emails and a Facebook community page keep members connected. The Black Rose Acoustic Society has created a welcoming inclusive environment where acoustic music thrives and friendships form through shared musical experiences.
location: Various Locations - Black Forest Community Center Beth-el Mennonite Church Buffalo Lodge

title: The Black Sheep
venue_description:
Overview

The Black Sheep has been providing a space for live music in Colorado Springs for over 14 years. Located at 2106 E Platte Ave in the Knob Hill Arts District this standing room only venue features both local and national performers across all genres with a cutting-edge punk and indie-rock vibe enhanced by graffiti art throughout the space.

Music Programming

The venue hosts concerts and events year-round featuring diverse musical acts. Shows are all ages unless otherwise stated and a full bar is available for those 21 and up. With a capacity that creates an intimate concert experience The Black Sheep has become the Springs premier all-ages music venue since opening in 2005. The venue has hosted countless local bands and touring acts across genres including punk rock metal indie alternative and more.

Venue Details

This standing room only concert hall provides an up-close experience with performers. Tickets are available in advance at blacksheeprocks.com or at The Black Sheep box office on show nights. The venue features professional sound and lighting systems. The graffiti-covered walls and intimate atmosphere create a unique concert environment beloved by both performers and fans. Located next door to Vultures the venues share the Knob Hill Arts District location.

Community Impact

For nearly two decades The Black Sheep has been a vital part of Colorado Springs music scene providing opportunities for emerging artists and bringing touring acts to the city. The all-ages policy makes live music accessible to younger fans and creates an inclusive environment. The venue continues to be recognized as the number one independent live music venue in Colorado Springs.
location: 2106 E Platte Ave Colorado Springs CO 80909
